'''Outer Rim Supply Co.''' was a company that was active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It featured a multi-[[color]]ed sign stating the business' name in a white [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] font set against a vivid red and dark reddish-brown backdrop. One such sign was put up as an advertisement in [[Stobar Spaceport/Legends|Stobar Spaceport]].<ref name="Brothers" />
